tagline: The Gulf's high-surge island — Full Moon demand, thin transit.
summary: Koh Phangan sits ~12nm north of Koh Samui and ~30nm south of Koh Tao, forming the core of the Samui Gulf triangle. Its economy swings on tourism surges (Full Moon Party) where ferry/speedboat capacity is the binding constraint. A quiet, zero-wake electric shuttle is a premium answer for resort and event transfers.

demand_signals.detail: Monthly events draw 10k-30k visitors to Haad Rin, overwhelming pier and road capacity.
Daily worker and supply movement on the ~12nm Bangrak-Thong Sala corridor.

journeys.note: Core commuter corridor; sealed in corridors model.

navier_fit: High. Short, high-frequency corridors well within Pioneer II range; premium transfer willingness-to-pay; Thong Sala pier already a multi-operator hub for pedestal siting.
competitive_landscape: Lomprayah, Raja Ferry, Seatran Discovery on the Samui/Phangan/Tao triangle; all diesel, schedule-bound, capacity-capped at peaks.
seasonality: Peak: Dec-Mar dry season + monthly Full Moon. Monsoon Oct-Nov raises Gulf swell; range-gate to short hops.
regulatory_note: Thai cabotage; domestic passenger operations via Marine Department licensing. Foreign-flag/charter rules apply — partner-of-record likely a local operator.

grab.super_app_fit: Grab in-app boat-transfer booking + last-mile GrabCar/GrabBike pier handoff at Bangrak and Thong Sala.
grab.wedge: Bundle event-surge transfers (Full Moon) into Grab as a premium, pre-booked, zero-wait alternative to pier queues.

transit_planning.note: Thong Sala is the inter-island hub; Haad Rin is event-driven.

_enrichment.note: Connected city brief hung off the Koh Samui / Gulf flagship. Geometry sealed via Grok from Bucket-C BP files.
